package.name: ur5_mtc
package.description:
The pick as a MoveIt Task Constructor graph, so a failed pick names the stage that pruned it instead of returning one boolean.
C++ rather than Python, and not by preference. MTC's Python bindings cannot build a PipelinePlanner (it takes an rclcpp::Node, which neither moveit_py nor the MTC bindings hand out) and Task.plan fails with "context argument is null" even using only interpolation planners. Every upstream MTC demo is C++ for the same reason. The attempt and its failure are recorded in the README so the next person does not repeat it.
